a 'Bri U Hynniewlrep’ (RI HYNNIEWTREP) ka
kynthup ia baroh ki ‘Hiina’ bad ‘Elaka’ la ki sahkum
ki ‘Khasi States’ ne ki kylla long ‘British Areas’. Ha
ki por synshar Phareng namar ki jingjia kiba phcr ba pherdon
ia kiba la pynsah kum ki ‘Khasi State' bad don pat ia kiba la
pynkyllakum ki ‘British Areas’. Hynrei kane kajinglehjong
ki Phareng kaba don jingiasnoh ruh bad ka buit synsharjong
ki, ba laju tip kum ka ‘Divide and Rule Policy' kam teh ia ki
‘Khasi States' bad ia i ‘British Areas’ ba kin hap sngcw ba ki
iaplierkum kajait bynriew. Kapynkynmaw iaka ‘Statement
’
kaba 5 tarik July 1947 jong u Sardar Patel, kaba ha kawei ka
bynia long ka la thoh kumne :
‘This country with its institutions is a proud heritage
ofthe peoplewho inhabit it. It is an accident thatsome live
in the Statesandsome in British India, but all alikepartake
of its culture and character. We are all knit together by
bonds of blood and feelings no less than of self interest.
None can segregate us into segments; no impassable
barriers can be set up between us’.
Hadien ka jingsoi ia ka ‘Treaty of Yandaboo’ ha ka 24
tarik Februaty 1826, ki Phareng ki la pynlong ia ka ‘Assam’
ka bynta jong ka Bengal, bad la buh ia ka Assam hapoh ka
jingkhmih jong u Commissioner (ym dei hapoh u Chief
Commissioner;hapohu CliiefCommissionertedei haduhynda
laweng ia kanaka Bengal badpynlongChiefCommissioner’s
Province ia ka ha ka snem 1874). Ki ‘Khasi States’ (bad kito

ki Hima Khasi bad byntajong ki Hima Khasi ba la pynkylla
‘British Areas’) te ki hap hapoh u Political agent jong ka
Cossyah Hills Political Agency. U Political Agent uba
nyngkong u dei u C’ol. Listeruba la shimti ia kakam Political
Agentha ka 1 1 tarik b'ebruary 1835 bad ka Headquarterjong ii
ka dei ka Sohra. Katto kalne bnai hadicn ba u Col. Lister u la
shimti ia kakam political Agent, ki Phareng ki la dakliol na ka
Hima Sutnga (lane hima .laintia) ia ka ‘Jayanta Pargana' bad
pyniasoh ia ka bad ka Sylhel District. Nangta ki la dakhol ruh
ia ka ‘Gobha’ bad pyniasoh ia ka bad ka Nowgong District.
Namarba uRajendra Singhum trehban long Syiem tangha ki
jaka lum (hill portion) jong ka Hima Jaintia, kumta ia kine ki
jaka lum (hill portion) jong ka hima Jaintia ba la khot hadien
'Jaintia Hills' ki lak>lla long 'BritishArea' hapohkajingkhmih
jongu Political AgentjongkaCossyah Hills Political Agency.
Ka laju long ka rukom ba ki khun ki hajar kiba shong ha
kijaka lumjong ka Hima Sutnga (lane Hima Jaintia) ki ju leit
ai ‘Blang’ sha Jaintiapur ha u Syiem ha ki por ‘Pomblang",
namaru Syiem u dei uba la kylla Hindu. Kane kajingai ka dei
beit kajingai sngewbha. Lehse lada u Syiem u dei u Khristan,
ki jin da leit ai ‘Sniang' ha ki por ba u Syiem u pynlong ka
jingkhawai Christmas. Hynrci ki Phareng ki pynbeit noh ba
kito kibaju leit ai ‘Blang' sha Jaintiapur ha ki por 'Pomblang'
kin hap leit ai noh sha u 'Officer’ ka sorkarPhareng ha Sohra.
la ki ‘Blang' ba la ai ki Phareng ki die lilam. Kat kum ka
paragraph 71 (hynniew phew wei)jong ka Reportjong uWJ
Allen (1858) kajingmih na kaba die ia ki blang ha ka sncm
1853-54ka longRs. 3 1/3 (laiphewwei tyngka lai anna). Nangta
ha ka snem 1857-58 ka long Rs. 129/13/6 (shispah arphew
khyndai tyngka, khadlai ana, hynriew damli).

Ka kam jong u Political Agent jong ka Cossyah Hills
Political Agency ka dei shaphang kaba peit ia ki kam synshar
(Civil Administration) bad kumjuh kaba khmih ia ka kam
pyniaid (command) ia ka kynhun shipai bad ha kata ka por ka
kynhun shipai ka dei ka ‘Sylhet Light Infantry'. La ong ba
hadien ia ka kyrteng jong kane ka kynhun shipai la pynkylla
bad la khotka 8thGurkha Rifles. Don kiba dangkynmaw ia ki
nongialehkai 'foolbalL ba donnam jong kane ka 8th Gurkha
Rifles kiba la ialehkai ha ki por ba ka Shillong Government
High School ruhka dangpawbhahakajingialehkai ‘footbalL.
I'o ngin ia phai biang sha Sohra ka Headquartersjong u
Political Agent. Shipor, ha ka por ba u Col. Lister u leit sha
Bilat la shimti ia ka kam Political Agent da u LieutenantGN
Cave. Ha ka por ba u LieutenantGN Cave u dang bat ia ka
kam Political Agent, la mih ka hokum ha ka snem 1854 na
'Fort William’ ba ia ka kam pyniaid (Command) ia ka kam
shipai bad la kakam synsharkhadar (Civil Administration)yn
ym p\'nkil shuh haujuhu Officer. Dei naduh kasnem 1854 ba
la duh noh ka Cossyah Hills Political Agency bad ba lamih ka
'Cossyahand Jynteah Hills District'. Tangba ki *Khasi States’
te kim hap hapoh ka Cossyah bad Jynteah Hills (Khasi and
Jintia Hills) District. la u Officeruba deikhmih iaka 'Cossyah
and Jynteah Hills District’ ha kato ka por kim khot u 'Deputy
Commissioner' hynrei ki khot u ‘Principal Assistant
Commssioner', bad u Principal Assistant Commissioner uba
nyngkong u dei uCK Hudsonuba la shimti ia kakamha ka 10
tarikApril 1 854.Kabaphyllaka long, imatymdonNotification
ba lapynmihpaidbahkaba iadei shaphang kabapynlong iaka
‘Cossyahand Jynteah Hills District’ badkumjuhruhshaphang
kabapynhap iakahapohuCommissionerka ‘Assam’ .Hakawei
ka byntajong ka paragraph 5jong ka reportjong uWJ Allen
(1858) la thoh kumne:

No public Notification, however, has been published,
either by the Government or the Local Authorities, regarding
the transfer of this district to the jurisdiction of the
Commissioner of Assam, and the public has never been
officiallyinfonnedwhat laws,mles andregulations are in force
in this Hill ferritory’.
Shipor, hadien uCK Hudson la long Principal Assistant
Commissioneru JB Shadwell, bad nangta la long u MajorLA
Rowlatt. Ha ka jingiakhih ki khun ki hajar ka Hima Sutnga
(lane Hima Jaintia) pyrshab ia ki Pharcng ha ka snem 1860
(kaba ki Phareng ki khotka ‘Nongjngi Rebellion'), uneuSahep
u la leh than; kat kiba don wait don stieh, ki la shah knieh bad
la thang ia ki wait ki stieh. Kumta ia une u Sahep la sin 'U
Thang Stieh’. Ha ka snem 1861 la khot noh 'Deputy Com
missioner’ ha kajaka 'Principal Assistant Commissioner' bad
u MajorEA Rowlatt u la kylla long u Deputy C'ommissioner
uba nyngkong jong ka 'Cossyah and Jynteah Hills District’.
Shipor, hadienjong u, la long uBWD Morton.
Ka Shillong ka long ka byntajong ka ‘Hima Shillong’.
I a iathuh ba u Bormanik u dei u Syiem uba khadduh ehjong
ka ‘Hima Shillong’ (kaba kynthup ia ka ‘Hima Nongkrem'
bad ‘Hima Mylliem’). Ha ka snem 1830 ei ei, ki 'Bakhraw'
jong ka ‘Hima Shillong’ ki la sdang ban ia don liang bad ka
'Hima Shillong’ ka la sdang ban or. Kajingkylli kaba mih ka
long la ka ‘Hima Shillong' ka pait ne ia ka ‘Hima Shillong’ la
phiah. Kane ka dei kawei patka bynta ban iakren. La iathuh ba
u Syiem uba nyngkongjong ka ‘Hima Mylliem’ u dei u Hajar
Sing. Hadien u Hajar Sing la long Syiem u Mile Sing. Ha ka
snem 1861, la don kajingiateh kular (Agreement) hapdeng, u
Mile Sing bad ka British Government na ka bynta ban aijaka
ia ka British Government ban seng shnong (‘establish civil
and military sanitaria, posts and cantonments’) Kijaka ba
IV

la shim ha Shillong ki long kat kum ba la batai ha ka
‘Agreement' ba la iasoi ha ka snem 1863 (Ref : Aitchison’s
Collections of Treaties, Vol 1 pp 247-250). la kane ka
‘Agreement’ lah ruh ban shem ha ka kot ‘KIHIMA KHASI,
pp 16-19. Kumba ka ‘Ktien Sohra’ kam dei shuh ka ‘Ktien
Pdeng’ tang jong ki nong Sohra, hynrei ka la dei ka ‘Ktien
Pdeng’jonguPaidka ri, ‘NaduhRilanghaduh Kupli’,kumjuh
ruh ka Shillong kam dei shiih ka ‘Pdeng’ tang jong ka Hima
Mylliem, hynreika la dei ka ‘Pdeng’jonguPaid ka Ri ‘Naduh
Rilang haduh Kupli’ khamtam ha ka liang ka sain hima sima.
Ha ka jingiadei bad ka Shillong, ha ka liang ka synshar
badka bishar lamih bun tylli ki Notification, ki Rule, ki Order
bad kumta ter ter. Ha Shillong ka don ka Municipal Board
kaba peit ia kikam ‘municipal’, kadonka ‘Dorbar kiBakhraw
bad u Syiem’ jong ka Hima Mylliem kaba don la kajong ka
jylli treikam; ka don ka State Revenue Department; ka don ka
State Forest Department; ka don ka Cantonment Board kaba
don la kajong ka jylli treikam, ka don ka Sessions Division
bad udon u Session Judge ubadon la kajong kajylli terikam;
kadon ka ‘District ofShillong’ badudonu DistrictJudge uba
don la kajong ka jylli treikam; ka don ka District Council; u
don u Deputy Commissioner; ki don ki ‘Assistants to the
Deputy Commissioner’; udonu Superintendent ofPolice; ki
don ki ‘Dorbar Shnong’ bad kumta ter ter. Haba shu kren
lyngkot teka Shillongkadapda ki ‘mawpud’ bad ki ‘mynsain’
;
lehse don na ki, kiba dangpaw tyngkrein bad don pat kiba la
jan dam. Ha kawei ka byntajong ka jingthohjong u Mr.HG
Dennehy, Chief Secretary to the Government ofAssam ha ka
snem 1929 ha ka recorded file (Local Self-Government - A
September,Nos 1-13-Revisionoftheboundariesofthe Shillong
Municipality) ka don kawei ka sentence - ‘There is more in
this than meets the eye’. Bad ha kawei pat ka byntajong ka

jingthohjonguMrBNRau, LegalRemembrancer,Government
ofAssam ha katei hi kajuh ka recorded file ka don kawei ka
sentence - ‘But in fact, the two things are not the same’.

DORBAR, HIMA MYLLIEM na ka bynta kajing ia snoh kti
lem ha kaba pynmih ia kane ka kot bn la jer kyrteng KA

1 . Ua ka snem 1854 la thung ia u sahep uba kyrtengu Mr.
C.K. Hudson ban long u Principal Assistant Commissioner
jong ka Khasi and Jaintia Hills District. Hadien, ia u Sahep
uba dei khmih ia ka Kliasi& Jaintia Hills District la khot noh
u Deputy Commissioner, Ha ka snem 1861 la don ka
jingpyrkhat ban pynkynriah noh ia ka District Headquarters
na Sohra sha Shillong- te ha ka snem 1863, ha ka por ba long
Deputy CommissionerU Colonel Bivar, ka SorkarPhareng ka
la shimjaka na ka Hima Mylliem ha ka por ba long Syiem U
Mile Singh. Kata ka jaka ba la shim ka long kat kum ba la
batai hakaAgreementJongkasnem 1863 {Appendix I).Naduh
ka snem 1864 ter-ter la sdang ban pynkhuid ia kijaka ki puta,
bad tei ia ki iing ki sem kiba donkam. Ia ka Ingshari (Deputy
Commissioner’s Office Building) la tei dep ha ka snem 1866,
badnaduh kata kasnem ka Shillongka la kylla long ka District
Headquartersjong ka Khasi& Jaintia Hills District.
2. Hadienba ka Shillongka la kylla long ka Headquarters
jong ka Khasi& Jaintia Hills District, ka la kylla long ruh ka
“Capital” jong ka Assam Province (Chief Commissioner’s
Province), bad kata ka la long ha ka snem 1874.Kum ban shu
pynkynmaw hangne, dei hadien ka Treaty ofYandaboo (24th
February 1826)bakaAssam ka la kylla longka Divisionjong
1

kaBengal Province, bad kaGauhati ka la longkaHeadquarters
jong ka Assam Division. Hynrei hadien, kat kuni ka
ProclamationNo. 379 dated the 6th Februaiy 1874, {Appendix
If), U Governor -General u la shirati noh ia ka bor bad
jingp)Tiiaidnau Lieutenant-GovernorofBengal ia ki shiphew
tylli ki District (Goalpara, Kamrup, Nowgong, Darrang,
Sibsagar, Lakhimpur. Cachar, Garo, Khasi& Jaintia Hills bad
NagaHills), badnangta katkum ka NotificationNo. 380 dated
the 6th February 1874 {Appendix III) la pynlong ia ka Assam
Province (Chief Commissioner’s Province) kaba kynthup ia
kitei ki District. la ka Sylhetbad ia ka Lushai Hills lapynwan
hapoh kaAssam Provincekham hadien. Shuh-Shuh, kum ban
shu pynkynmaw, ka "‘Khasi & Jaintia Hills District” kam
kynthup ia kijakakibahaphapoh ki “Khasi States”.Ka “Khasi
& Jaintia Hills” ka kynthup tang ki kijaka ba la khot “British
Areas”, kum ka Jowai Subdivision, ka Shillong (British
Portion),ka Saitsohpen, kaNongpoh,ka Laitlyngkotbadkiwei-
kiwei.
3. Ka long ka jingjia kaba yn sah iathuh khana ba ka
Gauhatikaba la longkaHeadquartersJong kaAssam Division,
kam shym la ioh ia ka kyrdan ban long ka “Capital”jong ka
Assam Province (ChiefCommissioner’s Province). Kat kum
ka Notification No. 49 dated Shillong the 20th March 1874
{AppendixIV) lapynbnabaka Shillongka lalongka“Capital”
Jong kaAssam Province naduh katei ka tarik (20 tarik March
1874).UChiefCommissionerubanyngkongehjongkaAssam
Province (Chief Commissioner’s Province) u dei u Lt. Col.
R.H. Keatings.
4. Kumba 6 (hynriew) snem ei-ei, naduh ka snem 1905
haduh 1911, ka Shillong ka la duh noh ia kajinglongkum ka
2

‘Capilarjong ka Province. Hapoh kine ki snem ia ka Bengal
la phiah, ha ki ar bynla. Ia ka Assam la pyniasoh lang bad ka
Eastern Bengal hapoh kakyrtengthymmai “ easternBengal&
Assam’' bad ka ‘Capital’ ka la longka Dacca. Kane kajingpyn
beit ka la neh shipor, bad ka Bengal ka la long biang kawei ka
Province. Ka Assam ruh ka la kylla long Province biang, bad
la pynlong biang ia ka Shillong ka '‘Capital”jong ka Assam.
Hadien, kat kum ka Government of India Act, 1919 na ka
kyrdan Cliief Commissioner’s Province, ka Assam ka la poi
sha ka kyrdan Governor's Province. Ka Shillong ka la iai sah
milkum ka ‘Capital’JongkaAssamhaduh ka 25 tarikJanuary
1974. U Governor uba nyngkong ehjong ka Assam Province
(Governor’s Province) u dei u SirNicholasDodd Beatson Bell.
5.Naduhka26 tarikJanuary 1974,ka Shillongkamshym
long shuh ka “Capital” jong ka Assam. la ka jingpynbna
{Appendix V) lapynmihha kaAssam Cazette (Fixtraordinary).
U Chief Secretary jong ka Assam Government, Shri
Dhamiananda Dasu la pule iakajingpynbna (Notification) ha
khmat u paidbah uba wan sha ka jingpyndonburom ia ka
Republic Day ha Gauhati (Dispur) bad ka jingpynbna
(Notification) ha ka ktien Phareng ka long kumne—
“Consequent upon formation of the State ofMeghalaya
under Section 5 ofthe North-Eastern Areas (Reorganisation)
Act, 197 1 (ActNo. 8 1 of 197 1 )read withGovernmentofIndia's
Notification No. GSR 18 (E), dated the 6th January 1972 the
governor ofAssam is pleased to transfer the headquarters of
the state Government ofAssam from Shillong in Meghalaya
to Dispur in the Kamrup District ofAssam with effect from
the 26th day ofJanuary 1974.
3

The GovernorofAssam is further pleased to declare that
Dispur in the district of Kamrup shall henceforth be the
temporary Capital ofthe State ofAssam”.
6. Ka lah ban long kajingjia ryngkhat ne ka lah ban long
kajingleh khnang hynrei kajingshisha te ka sah ba ka Assam
Government ka la pynbeit ba ka Shillong kan dang long hi ka
‘CapitaT kaAssam sa katto katne sngi hadien ba kut ka snem
1973. Da kata ka jingpynbeit, ka Shillong ka la ioh ban dap
100 (shispah) snem kum ka ‘Capital' ka Assam. La don ka
jingkhmih lynti ba ka Assam Government kan pyndonburom
ia ka jingdap 100 (shispah) snem jong ka Shillong kum ka
‘Capital' ka Assam, hynrei tang 25 sngi (kata naduh ka 1 tarik
haduh 25 tarik) ka long ka por kaba lyngkot shibun eh. I ah
ban shim ba kine ki 25 (arphew san) sngi ki long ki sngi
pyndonburom jong ka Assam Government ia ka Jingdap 100
(shispah) snemjong ka Shillong kum ka ‘CapitaT ka Assam,

(Gauhati) ha ka snem 1973, tc ka Shillong kanjin da la duh ia
ka nam ba ka la long ka ‘Capital' ka Assam 100 (shispah)
snem.
7.Haka 2 1 tarikJanuary 1972 lapynlong ia kaMeglialaya
State, bad ka Shillongka la long ka ‘Capital'jongkaMeghlaya
State naduh kalei ka sngi. Ka Shillong ka la long ka ‘Capital'
jong ki ar tylli ki “State” (Assam bad Meghalaya) tang katto-
katne bnai katanaduh ka 2 1 tank January 1972 haduh 25 tarik
January 1974.
8. To ngin ia phai mynta sha ki kam ‘municipal'. Dei
naduh ka snem 1878 ba ka Shillong ka la ioh ia ka kyrdan
“Station” kat kum ki ‘provisions’ jong ka Bengal Municipal
4

Act, 1876. Ha ka snem 1878 la pynmih ia ka Proclamation
dated the 26thNovember 1878 {Appendix VI) pule langbadka
NotificationNo. 193 dated the 26 November 1 878 {Appendix
VII). la katei ka Proclamation la pynmih hadien ba u Syiem

lah batai ha ka Agreementjong ka snem 1863 {Appendix I).

X) na u Syiemjong ka Hima Mylliem.
